feature_semantics: 18 angle mean/range + 10 corrected pressure descriptors + 19 anthropometric fields; no moments, no FPI scores, no subject centering
restricted_acquisition_rule: select n training people, then k trials per person; unselected trials/people are NaN and must never reach scaler or model
person_feature: median over the k retained trials of each descriptor (median of features, not of probabilities), concatenated with anthropometry
test_assessment: fixed: 14 recorded held-out people, all five trials, median features, training-fitted scaler

primary_contrast.pairing: B people subset of A people; A trials subset of B trials; same test people

secondary_outputs: observed finite differences along n at fixed k and along k at fixed n; no derivatives, ratios, extrapolation or saturation wording
auxiliary: within-session ICC(1,1), ICC(1,k) of 28 descriptors on training people only; measurement-reliability context, not an accuracy predictor

classifier.C_justification: selected in 14/15 outer folds for every k in internal_trial_budget_study_v1/inner_tuning.csv, recorded before any new result

uncertainty: class-stratified person bootstrap over test people retaining draws/repeats, conditional on fitted models; between-draw SD reported separately
study_type: exploratory empirical evaluation of a learning surface under restricted acquisition; single previously examined cohort
permitted_description: an empirical evaluation of the learning surface under restricted acquisition

provenance.builder: corrected_raw_pipeline_diagnostic.py::build_raw from dataset/DATA.mat; every descriptor is a function of its own trial only; subject-centered columns not loaded
